thailand_result.summary: You need to file the Thailand Digital Arrival Card (TDAC).

forms.name: TDAC
forms.deadline: Within 3 days before arrival

thailand_result.note: All foreign visitors must file the TDAC. It is always free. Anyone charging you is a middleman.

options.label: By air to a major airport (CUN, MEX, GDL, TIJ, PVR, SJD, etc.)
By air to a smaller airport

mexico_air_major.summary: You probably do NOT need a separate FMM-E.
mexico_air_major.note: Most major Mexican airports (CUN, MEX, GDL, TIJ, PVR, SJD) now use a passport stamp instead of a separate FMM. The stamp itself authorizes your stay, no separate filing needed.
mexico_air_major.fallback_label: Read the FMM overview if unsure
mexico_air_major.fallback_warning: If you want extra safety, file the FMM-E anyway (free, takes 10 min). It's never a problem at the border to have one filed.

mexico_need.summary: You need to file the FMM-E (Forma Migratoria Múltiple Electrónica).

forms.name: FMM-E
forms.deadline: Any time before arrival; up to 30 days out

mexico_need.note: Land, sea, and smaller-airport entries still require the FMM-E. Free on the INM site. Keep the stub the border officer hands you until you exit Mexico.

dominican_result.summary: You need to file the Dominican Republic E-Ticket.

forms.name: E-Ticket
forms.deadline: Within 72 hours before arrival

dominican_result.note: All arrivals and departures need the E-Ticket. One filing covers both directions of your trip. Free at the .gob.do site.

options.label: Brunei or Thailand passport entering by land
Pure transit at KUL (not clearing immigration)

malaysia_exempt.summary: You are EXEMPT from filing the MDAC.
malaysia_exempt.note: Singapore citizens, Malaysian citizens / PRs, Brunei and Thailand passport holders entering by land, pure airside transit travelers, and certain diplomatic passports do not need the MDAC. Just bring your passport.

malaysia_need.summary: You need to file the Malaysia Digital Arrival Card (MDAC).

forms.name: MDAC
forms.deadline: Within 3 days before arrival

malaysia_need.note: Free at the .gov.my site. Officer scans your passport at immigration; the MDAC submission auto-pulls.

options.label: ASEAN citizen (Singapore, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, Philippines, etc.)
Europe (Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Italy, Norway, Russia, Spain, Sweden, UK, Belarus)
Other (US, Canada, Australia, China, India, etc.)

vietnam_visa_exempt.summary: You can enter Vietnam visa-free for tourism (typically 15-45 days, depending on your nationality).
vietnam_visa_exempt.note: No e-visa needed for visa-exempt nationalities. Just bring your passport. Verify your specific stay limit on the official Vietnam Immigration Department page before flying.
vietnam_visa_exempt.fallback_label: Read the e-visa guide for context

forms.name: E-Visa (single-entry)
forms.deadline: Apply 3-5 working days before flight

vietnam_need_evisa.note: $25 USD is the official government fee. Anyone charging more is a middleman. Multi-entry option ($50) and express ($50 surcharge) are also government tiers. Commercial sites typically charge $99-179 for the same e-visa.

options.label: US, EU, UK, Canada, Australia, Japan, Korea, Singapore (visa-free since 2024)

indonesia_ecd_only.summary: You need the All Indonesia arrival declaration. No visa required.

forms.name: All Indonesia
forms.agency: Direktorat Jenderal Imigrasi / Bea dan Cukai
forms.deadline: Within 3 days before arrival

indonesia_ecd_only.note: All arrivals need the free arrival declaration. Visa-free nationalities don't need a separate e-VOA. Use the official .go.id portal.

indonesia_both.summary: You need BOTH the All Indonesia arrival declaration and the e-VOA (visa).

forms.name: All Indonesia
forms.agency: Direktorat Jenderal Imigrasi / Bea dan Cukai
forms.deadline: Within 3 days before arrival

forms.name: e-VOA
forms.deadline: Apply before flight

indonesia_both.note: Two separate official flows. Don't let middlemen bundle them: the arrival declaration is free and the e-VOA has a real $35 government fee.

options.label: Pure airside transit at Changi (not clearing immigration)
Foreign visitor or Singapore PR returning

singapore_exempt.note: Singapore citizens entering on a Singapore passport, and pure airside transit travelers, are exempt. Just bring your passport.

singapore_need.summary: You need to file the Singapore Arrival Card (SGAC).

forms.name: SGAC
forms.deadline: Within 3 days before arrival

singapore_need.note: Free at the .gov.sg site. Includes a brief health declaration. eGate-eligible nationalities scan their passport on arrival; the SGAC submission auto-pulls.

philippines_result.summary: You need to file Philippines eTravel.

forms.name: eTravel
forms.deadline: Before check-in / arrival

philippines_result.note: Free at the .gov.ph site. eTravel is a travel declaration, not a visa.

cambodia_result.summary: You need the Cambodia e-Arrival declaration.

forms.name: e-Arrival
forms.deadline: Before arrival

cambodia_result.note: The arrival declaration is free. Visa fees are separate when your trip requires a visa.

japan_result.summary: You can use Visit Japan Web for Japan arrival QR workflows.

forms.name: Visit Japan Web
forms.deadline: Before arrival; paper fallback may exist

japan_result.note: Visit Japan Web is free and separate from visa status. Some airport flows can still use paper forms.

korea_result.summary: You need the Korea e-Arrival Card when the official portal applies to your trip.

forms.name: e-Arrival Card
forms.deadline: Before arrival

korea_result.note: Free at the .go.kr portal. This is separate from K-ETA, visa status, and Q-Code.

usa_passport.label: Is your passport from a Visa Waiver Program country?

usa_esta_result.summary: You need an approved ESTA before traveling under the Visa Waiver Program.

forms.name: ESTA
forms.deadline: No later than 72 hours before departure

usa_esta_result.note: ESTA is a travel authorization, not a visa. Eligible Visa Waiver Program travelers need it for air, sea, and land entry. Approval does not guarantee admission.

usa_visa_result.summary: You may need a U.S. visa instead of ESTA.
usa_visa_result.note: If your passport is not covered by the Visa Waiver Program, or you are not sure you meet every condition, check the U.S. embassy or consulate visa guidance for your passport and trip.
usa_visa_result.fallback_label: Read the ESTA overview and Visa Waiver Program check

options.label: I already have a UK visa or UK immigration status
Passport from an ETA-eligible visa-free country

uk_none_result.summary: You do not need a UK ETA.
uk_none_result.note: British and Irish citizens do not need an ETA. You also do not need one if you already have a UK visa or permission to live, work, or study in the UK.

uk_eta_result.summary: You need an approved UK ETA before traveling.

forms.name: ETA
forms.deadline: Before you travel; allow up to 3 working days

uk_eta_result.note: A UK ETA is a travel authorization, not a visa. It is valid for 2 years or until the linked passport expires and covers multiple journeys. Every traveler, including a baby or child, needs a separate application.

uk_visa_result.summary: You may need a UK visa instead of an ETA.
uk_visa_result.note: If your passport is not ETA-eligible, or you are not sure you meet the ETA conditions, check the official UK visa guidance for your nationality and trip.
uk_visa_result.fallback_label: Read the UK ETA overview and eligibility check

options.label: By air, including connecting through a Canadian airport
By car, bus, train, or cruise ship
U.S. citizen or U.S. lawful permanent resident

canada_eta_result.summary: You need an approved Canada eTA before flying or connecting through a Canadian airport.

forms.name: eTA
forms.deadline: Before you book or board your flight

canada_eta_result.note: A Canada eTA is valid for up to 5 years or until the linked passport expires, whichever comes first. It supports multiple entries and does not guarantee admission.

canada_none_result.summary: You do not need a Canada eTA for this trip.
canada_none_result.note: Travelers arriving by car, bus, train, or cruise ship normally do not need an eTA. U.S. citizens are exempt. U.S. lawful permanent residents have also been exempt since April 26, 2022; when flying, carry a valid passport plus a valid green card or other proof of U.S. status accepted by IRCC.

canada_visa_result.summary: You may need a Canadian visitor visa instead of an eTA.
canada_visa_result.note: If your passport is visa-required, or you are not sure you meet the eTA conditions, check the official Canada.ca eligibility guidance for your passport, travel history, and route.
canada_visa_result.fallback_label: Read the Canada eTA overview and eligibility check

options.label: Visa-waiver passport, or arriving by cruise

nz_nztd_only_result.summary: You need to file the New Zealand Traveller Declaration (NZTD).

forms.name: NZTD
forms.deadline: Within 24 hours before departure

nz_nztd_only_result.note: Every person entering New Zealand must complete the free NZTD. Australian citizens travelling on Australian passports do not need an NZeTA.

nz_nztd_nzeta_result.summary: You need both the free NZTD and an approved NZeTA.

forms.name: NZTD
forms.deadline: Within 24 hours before departure

forms.name: NZeTA
forms.deadline: Allow up to 72 hours before booking travel

nz_nztd_nzeta_result.note: NZTD and NZeTA are separate. Visa-waiver air travellers, cruise passengers, Australian permanent residents, and some transit travellers need an NZeTA. IVL exemptions apply, including for Australian permanent residents.

nz_visa_result.summary: You need the free NZTD and may need a New Zealand visa.

forms.name: NZTD
forms.deadline: Within 24 hours before departure

nz_visa_result.note: Complete the free NZTD, then check the official New Zealand visa requirements for your passport and trip. An NZeTA does not replace a visa when a visa is required.
nz_visa_result.fallback_label: Read the NZTD overview and visa guidance

australia_passport.label: Which passport are you travelling on?

options.label: ETA-eligible passport (including US, Canada, Japan, South Korea, Singapore, Hong Kong, Malaysia, Brunei)

australia_eta_result.summary: You need an approved ETA 601 before travelling to Australia.

forms.name: ETA (subclass 601)
forms.deadline: Before you travel; app only

australia_eta_result.note: ETA 601 has no official web application form. Apply only in the AustralianETA App from the Department of Home Affairs. There is no Visa Application Charge, but each App application carries an AUD $20 service fee.

australia_evisitor_result.summary: You can apply online for the free eVisitor 651.

forms.name: eVisitor (subclass 651)
forms.deadline: Before you travel; apply online through ImmiAccount

australia_evisitor_result.note: Eligible European passport holders can apply for eVisitor 651 online through Home Affairs and ImmiAccount without a government application fee. It normally permits multiple visits during 12 months, with stays of up to 3 months each.

australia_visa_result.summary: You may need another Australian visa.
australia_visa_result.note: If your passport is not eligible for ETA 601 or eVisitor 651, or you are not sure, use the official Home Affairs guidance to find the visa that matches your passport and trip. Do not use a website claiming to offer an official web ETA form.
australia_visa_result.fallback_label: Read the ETA 601 and eVisitor 651 overview

options.label: I already have an Indian visa or OCI card

india_earrival_result.summary: You need to file the free India e-Arrival Card.

forms.name: e-Arrival Card
forms.agency: Bureau of Immigration, Ministry of Home Affairs
forms.deadline: Within 72 hours before arrival

india_earrival_result.note: Foreign nationals, including OCI cardholders, submit the free e-Arrival Card. It records arrival information and does not replace a visa or OCI status.

india_both_result.summary: You need the free e-Arrival Card and the Indian visa required for your trip.

forms.name: e-Arrival Card
forms.agency: Bureau of Immigration, Ministry of Home Affairs
forms.deadline: Within 72 hours before arrival

forms.name: e-Visa
forms.agency: Bureau of Immigration, Ministry of Home Affairs
forms.deadline: Apply before travel; check eligibility and the permitted entry ports

india_both_result.note: These are separate official procedures. The e-Arrival Card is free. e-Visa fees vary by nationality and validity, carry an additional 3% bank charge, and permit first entry only through listed airports and seaports.

india_unsure_result.summary: You need the free e-Arrival Card and must check your visa status separately.

forms.name: e-Arrival Card
forms.agency: Bureau of Immigration, Ministry of Home Affairs
forms.deadline: Within 72 hours before arrival

india_unsure_result.note: The free e-Arrival Card does not grant permission to travel. Check whether your passport and trip require an e-Visa or another Indian visa on the official indianvisaonline.gov.in service before departure.
india_unsure_result.fallback_label: Read the e-Arrival Card and e-Visa overview

turkey_passport.label: Which passport are you travelling on?

options.label: Visa-exempt passport (including US, UK, Canada, Australia, China, EU, and others)
Needs a valid Schengen/US/UK/Ireland visa to qualify

turkey_none_result.summary: You do not need a Turkey e-Visa or arrival form.
turkey_none_result.note: Visa-exempt visitors can stay for up to 90 days in any 180-day period without filing a form. Any site charging you for a Turkey visa is selling a need that does not exist for this trip.
turkey_none_result.fallback_label: Check your passport on the official visa-information page

turkey_evisa_result.summary: You need a Turkey e-Visa before travelling.

forms.name: e-Visa
forms.agency: Republic of Türkiye Ministry of Foreign Affairs
forms.deadline: Before you travel; apply at evisa.gov.tr

turkey_evisa_result.note: The official system displays the live fee after nationality, travel-document type, and travel dates are selected. Apply only at evisa.gov.tr.

turkey_conditional_result.summary: You may qualify for a conditional Turkey e-Visa.
turkey_conditional_result.note: Some passports, including India, Bangladesh, Pakistan, and the Philippines, may qualify only with a valid Schengen, US, UK, or Ireland visa or residence permit and every other condition shown by the official e-Visa system.

turkey_check_result.summary: Check the rule for your exact passport before paying.
turkey_check_result.note: Use the Ministry of Foreign Affairs list at mfa.gov.tr to check visa exemption, direct e-Visa eligibility, conditional eligibility, or another visa requirement for your passport and trip.
turkey_check_result.fallback_label: Open the Turkey visa and e-Visa guide

sri_lanka_fee_scheme.label: Is your passport in the free ETA scheme?

options.label: One of the 40 free-scheme nationalities, or Maldives, Seychelles or Singapore

sri_lanka_free_result.summary: You still need the ETA, and your fee is zero.

forms.name: ETA
forms.agency: Department of Immigration and Emigration, Sri Lanka
forms.deadline: Before travel; confirm the fee shows zero

sri_lanka_free_result.note: From 25 May 2026 the tourist ETA is free for 40 named nationalities plus Maldives, Seychelles and Singapore. Free means the fee is zero, not that the ETA is skipped. Maldivian nationals receive 90 days; other free-scheme tourists receive 30 days and double entry. Children under 12 and two-day transit are also free.

sri_lanka_paid_result.summary: You need the ETA, and your passport pays a fee.

forms.name: ETA
forms.agency: Department of Immigration and Emigration, Sri Lanka
forms.deadline: Before travel; the on-arrival route costs more

sri_lanka_paid_result.note: For passports outside the free scheme, the online tourist ETA is USD 20 for SAARC nationals and USD 50 for other nationalities. Applying on arrival costs more and can end in return travel if a referral is issued. Check the Department's fee table for the current amount before paying.

maldives_result.summary: You need the free IMUGA Traveller Declaration for arrival.

forms.name: Traveller Declaration
forms.deadline: Within 96 hours before arrival

maldives_result.note: All foreign arrivals submit the free declaration within the 96 hours before arrival. Outbound travellers are no longer required to submit it since 15 August 2024. The tourist visa is issued on arrival and has no pre-approval step, so the declaration does not replace it.

options.label: I hold an Alien Resident Certificate, Resident Visa, Diplomatic ID, or a Taiwan-area residence certificate
None of those / foreign visitor or specified permit holder

taiwan_none_result.summary: You do not submit the arrival card for this trip.
taiwan_none_result.note: The official homepage limits the arrival card to foreign nationals without an Alien Resident Certificate, Resident Visa or Diplomatic ID, specified Mainland, Hong Kong and Macao permit holders, and nationals without household registration who do not hold Taiwan-area residence certificates. Holding one of those residence documents means the arrival card is not your step.
taiwan_none_result.fallback_label: Read who submits the arrival card

taiwan_twac_result.summary: You need to submit the free Taiwan Arrival Card (TWAC).

forms.name: TWAC
forms.agency: National Immigration Agency, Ministry of the Interior
forms.deadline: Within 7 days before arrival

taiwan_twac_result.note: The arrival card is online only since 1 October 2025 and is free. The submission window is within 7 days before arrival, extended in July 2026. One person may file individually for up to 10 travellers, and the group-file import supports up to 16. No printout is needed at inspection because scanning the passport retrieves the record.

egypt_passport.label: Is your passport on the official eVisa list?

options.label: Yes, it is listed in the official eVisa FAQ

egypt_evisa_result.summary: You can apply for the Egypt e-Visa on the government portal.

forms.name: e-Visa
forms.agency: Ministry of Interior, Arab Republic of Egypt
forms.deadline: Create the application at least 7 days before departure

egypt_evisa_result.note: Current tourism fees are USD 30 single entry and USD 65 multiple entry. Approval and the download link arrive by email; a payment confirmation alone is not an approval. At entry the official checklist asks for a passport valid at least 6 months from arrival, a printed eVisa, an itinerary, hotel details for tourism, and a supporting letter for a business or family visit.

egypt_check_result.summary: Check your visa route with an Egyptian mission before you travel.
egypt_check_result.note: The official eVisa FAQ lists the eligible nationalities, so a passport outside that list cannot use the portal. This does not mean visa-free entry. Check with an Egyptian embassy or consulate, and check visa-on-arrival eligibility separately: embassy guidance states that travellers on the pre-approval list cannot obtain a visa on arrival, that Bangladeshi nationals require a visa before entry, and that airlines should confirm boarding eligibility.
egypt_check_result.fallback_label: Read the eligibility and visa-on-arrival limits

saudi_passport.label: Is your passport one of the 66 eligible for the tourist eVisa?

options.label: Yes, it is on the 66-country eVisa list

saudi_evisa_result.summary: You can apply for the Saudi tourist eVisa.

forms.name: Tourist eVisa
forms.deadline: Before travel; normally one year, multiple entry, up to 90 days

saudi_evisa_result.note: The portal is operated by the Ministry of Tourism, but its host is not a .gov.sa suffix, so reach it from the Saudi National Platform at my.gov.sa or from Visit Saudi and check the exact hostname before entering details. The SAR 300 base fee is not the total: mandatory medical insurance, VAT and the payment amount all affect checkout. The visa covers tourism, events, family and relative visits, leisure, and Umrah excluding Hajj. It does not cover Hajj, study or work.

saudi_alt_status.label: Do you hold a specified US, UK or Schengen visa or permanent residence, or GCC residency?

saudi_finder_result.summary: Use the KSA Visa Finder, because your eligibility is decided differently.

forms.name: KSA Visa Finder
forms.fee: Depends on the route the finder returns
forms.deadline: Before booking; the route decides the fee and conditions

saudi_finder_result.note: Holders of specified valid US, UK or Schengen visas or permanent residence, and GCC residents, are decided on different terms from the 66-country eVisa list. Transit visas, Umrah and Nusuk permits, Hajj visas and GCC-resident routes are separate products with their own conditions.

saudi_mission_result.summary: Check the current route through the visa finder or a Saudi mission.
saudi_mission_result.note: A passport outside the 66-country list is not visa-free. Use the current KSA Visa Finder on my.gov.sa or the KSA Visa platform at ksavisa.sa, or apply through a Saudi mission. Umrah and Hajj have their own routes: the Umrah visa through KSA Visa, the Umrah permit through Nusuk, and Hajj its own visa and permit.
saudi_mission_result.fallback_label: Read which Saudi visa route applies

kenya_eligibility.label: Does your passport or traveller status appear on Kenya's current eTA exemption list?

options.label: Yes, I confirmed an exemption on the Kenya portal
No, I confirmed that I need an eTA
I have not checked the current list

kenya_exempt_result.summary: You do not need a Kenya eTA under the exemption you confirmed.
kenya_exempt_result.note: Carry the passport or status evidence that supports the exemption. Do not pay for an eTA that the current Government of Kenya list says you do not need.

kenya_eta_result.summary: Apply for the Kenya Electronic Travel Authorisation before travel.

forms.name: Kenya eTA
forms.deadline: Allow at least three working days; travel only after approval

kenya_eta_result.note: The standard government fee is USD $30. Extra products or expedited processing can cost more. A receipt is not approval.

kenya_check_result.summary: Check Kenya's current exemption list before paying.
kenya_check_result.note: The current list includes EAC citizens, named passport nationalities and traveller-status exemptions. Confirm your exact passport and status on etakenya.go.ke first.

israel_eligibility.label: Which Israel entry route applies to your passport and visit?

options.label: Visa-exempt passport, short tourism or business visit
My passport requires an Israeli visitor visa
I hold an exempt Israeli status or valid Israeli visa

israel_eta_result.summary: Apply for ETA-IL before the short visit.

forms.name: ETA-IL
forms.deadline: Apply at least 72 hours before non-refundable travel arrangements

israel_eta_result.note: ETA-IL is only for visa-exempt citizens making an eligible short visit. The fee is non-refundable and approval does not guarantee admission.

israel_visa_result.summary: Do not apply for ETA-IL. Use the Israeli visitor-visa route.
israel_visa_result.note: ETA-IL does not convert a visa-required passport into a visa-exempt one. Paying ILS 25 here would not replace the required B/2 visitor visa.

israel_status_result.summary: Do not buy a second ETA-IL if your current Israeli status or visa is exempt.
israel_status_result.note: Verify that the passport and existing status remain valid for this trip. Use PIBA's eligibility check if the status has changed.

israel_check_result.summary: Check visa exemption before paying for ETA-IL.
israel_check_result.note: Start at the official gov.il eligibility page. Visa-exempt short visitors use ETA-IL; visa-required travellers use the visa route.

cuba_result.summary: Complete the free D'Viajeros form for the arriving trip.

forms.name: D'Viajeros
forms.agency: Cuban Ministry of Transport with immigration, customs and public-health services
forms.deadline: Within seven days before travel

cuba_result.note: Each arriving passenger files D'Viajeros for each arrival, including children. It is not the tourist visa. If the trip requires a tourist eVisa, obtain that separate paid code first, then enter it in D'Viajeros to produce the QR.

curacao_result.summary: Complete Curaçao's free Digital Immigration Card for each visitor.

forms.name: Digital Immigration Card
forms.agency: Curaçao Immigration through the Curaçao Tourist Board designated portal
forms.deadline: Within seven days before departure; no later than one hour before arrival

curacao_result.note: The designated host uses .com, not a government suffix. Verify it by following the DI Card link from curacao.com. The official DI Card itself never requires payment.

colombia_result.summary: You may file the free, optional Check-Mig pre-registration for this entry or exit.

forms.name: Check-Mig
forms.deadline: From 72 hours before travel until one hour before travel

colombia_result.note: Migración Colombia says Check-Mig is optional and recommended to speed up control. It is not a visa or admission approval, and the government service has no fee.

laos_eligibility.label: Did you confirm both eVisa eligibility and a designated entry port?

options.label: Yes, my passport is eligible and I will use one of the 9 eVisa ports

laos_evisa_result.summary: Apply for the Lao Tourist eVisa before travel.

forms.name: Lao Tourist eVisa
forms.agency: Consular Department, Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Lao PDR
forms.deadline: At least 5 days before arrival; normal processing is 3 working days

laos_evisa_result.note: The eVisa is single-entry tourism only, allows a 30-day stay, and works at 9 designated ports. Print the Approval Letter and carry the same passport used in the application.

laos_check_result.summary: Check the passport list and entry port before paying.
laos_check_result.note: Visa exemption, eVisa and visa on arrival are separate routes. An eVisa cannot be used at an undesignated port, and the official fee is not refunded in that case.

azerbaijan_passport.label: Does the current MFA visa-free list cover the passport and trip dates you will use?

azerbaijan_evisa_eligible.label: Does evisa.gov.az list your passport as eligible for an ASAN e-Visa?

azerbaijan_visa_free.summary: This trip follows Azerbaijan's current visa-free route.
azerbaijan_visa_free.note: No ASAN e-Visa form is required for this trip. Do not pay anyone to file one; carry evidence that the passport and travel dates meet the current MFA rule.

azerbaijan_apply.summary: Use the official ASAN e-Visa portal.

forms.name: ASAN Electronic Visa
forms.agency: State Agency for Public Service and Social Innovations under the President of Azerbaijan
forms.deadline: Apply at least 3 working days before arrival for standard service.

azerbaijan_apply.note: The e-Visa is single entry, valid for 90 days and permits a stay up to 30 days.

azerbaijan_consular.summary: The ASAN online route is not available for this passport.
azerbaijan_consular.note: Do not force an online application. Follow the Ministry of Foreign Affairs route for an Azerbaijani diplomatic mission or consulate.

myanmar_eligibility.label: Does your passport appear on the current Tourist eVisa eligibility list?

myanmar_evisa_result.summary: Apply for the Myanmar Tourist eVisa before travel.

forms.name: Myanmar Tourist eVisa
forms.fee: USD $50 in the official guide; confirm Step 5
forms.deadline: Allow at least 3 working days

myanmar_evisa_result.note: Single entry, 28-day stay, 90-day Approval Letter and 4 current entry points. Print one copy after approval.

myanmar_not_eligible.summary: Do not pay for the Tourist eVisa until the official list confirms eligibility.
myanmar_not_eligible.note: The Tourist and Business lists differ. Contact a Myanmar embassy or consulate for the correct visa route if the passport is not eligible.

nepal_route.label: Which passport or visa-on-arrival situation applies?

options.label: Chinese passport or another confirmed gratis category
Not eligible for visa on arrival or unsure

nepal_visa_exempt.summary: Indian citizens do not need a Nepal visa.
nepal_visa_exempt.note: No Tourist Visa form or fee is required. Check the current government entry-document rules before travel.

nepal_gratis_result.summary: Complete the applicable Tourist Visa process, but the visa fee may be waived.

forms.name: Nepal Online Tourist Visa Form
forms.agency: Department of Immigration, Government of Nepal
forms.deadline: Submit within 15 days before presenting the barcode receipt

nepal_gratis_result.note: Chinese nationals are a current gratis Tourist Visa category. Other free categories have conditions; confirm the exact category before travel.

nepal_voa_result.summary: Pre-fill the Tourist Visa form, then obtain the visa at the port.

forms.name: Nepal Online Tourist Visa Form
forms.agency: Department of Immigration, Government of Nepal
forms.deadline: Barcode receipt remains valid for 15 days

nepal_voa_result.note: The online receipt is not the visa. Present it with payment proof and the passport to the immigration officer.

nepal_advance_result.summary: Use the advance ETA or Nepalese-mission route instead of visa on arrival.

forms.name: NepaliPort ETA / Mission Visa Services
forms.agency: Department of Immigration, Government of Nepal
forms.deadline: Arrange before travel

nepal_advance_result.note: NepaliPort lists visa on arrival, ETA and mission visa as separate services. Do not submit the on-arrival form when the passport requires advance approval.

pakistan_route.label: Which Pakistan tourist-entry route applies to your passport?

options.label: Citizen of Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, UAE, Oman, Qatar or Bahrain
Passport is on the current Visa Prior to Arrival list

pakistan_visa_exempt.summary: The current GCC exemption requires no ETA or visa for tourism or business.
pakistan_visa_exempt.note: This route currently covers citizens of Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, the United Arab Emirates, Oman, Qatar and Bahrain, with stays up to 90 days. Recheck the official notice before travel.

pakistan_vpa_result.summary: Use the free Visa Prior to Arrival tourism application.

forms.name: Pakistan Visa Prior to Arrival
forms.agency: Directorate General of Immigration & Passports / NADRA
forms.deadline: Obtain the Visa Grant Notice before travel

pakistan_vpa_result.note: Download the issued Visa Grant Notice. Read that notice for validity, entries and permitted stay; do not infer a universal stay from the general eligibility page.

pakistan_regular_result.summary: Check the regular online visa or mission route before paying.

forms.name: Pakistan Online Visa System
forms.agency: Directorate General of Immigration & Passports / NADRA
forms.deadline: Arrange before travel

pakistan_regular_result.note: Regular visa fees are reciprocal. The free VPA is a separate product and is available only to currently eligible passports.

uzbekistan_route.label: Have you checked the current Uzbekistan visa-free list for this passport and trip?

options.label: Yes, this trip meets a current visa-free rule

uzbekistan_visa_free_result.summary: No eVisa form is required for a trip that meets the current visa-free rule.
uzbekistan_visa_free_result.note: No form and no eVisa fee. Follow the exact duration, passport and ticket conditions in the current MFA entry for that nationality.

uzbekistan_check_first.summary: Check the current MFA visa-free list before opening a paid eVisa application.
uzbekistan_check_first.note: Visa-free durations and conditions differ. Do not pay until the passport and trip have been checked against the current government page.

uzbekistan_evisa_eligibility.label: Does the passport appear in the current eVisa eligibility Appendix 1?

uzbekistan_evisa_result.summary: Apply through the official Uzbekistan eVisa portal.

forms.name: Uzbekistan eVisa
forms.agency: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Uzbekistan
forms.deadline: Apply at least 3 working days before arrival

uzbekistan_evisa_result.note: Consideration takes 2 working days excluding the filing day. The eVisa allows up to 30 days of stay and is valid for entry within 90 days from registration.

uzbekistan_mission_result.summary: Do not use the eVisa form until the current Appendix 1 confirms eligibility.
uzbekistan_mission_result.note: The portal directs passports outside the simplified eVisa list to the appropriate Uzbekistan foreign mission.

georgia_passport.label: What does Georgia's current visa-free list say about your passport?

options.label: My passport is on the one-full-year visa-free list
I need a visa and the official portal accepts my passport

georgia_none_result.summary: You do not need a Georgia e-Visa for this visa-free trip.
georgia_none_result.note: Citizens of countries in the current government annex may enter and stay without a visa for one full year. No form is required. Anyone charging for a Georgia e-Visa on this route is selling an application you do not need.

georgia_evisa_result.summary: Use the official Georgia e-Visa process.

forms.name: Georgia e-Visa
forms.agency: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Georgia
forms.deadline: Allow at least 5 working days; complete DuVerify within 24 hours

georgia_evisa_result.note: The current process has two mandatory paid steps. Visa validity and permitted stay depend on the selected passport.

georgia_check_result.summary: Check the current government list before paying.
georgia_check_result.note: Find the passport country in the current visa-free ordinance, then use the official e-Visa portal only if a visa is required and the portal accepts that travel document.

oman_eligibility.label: Which Oman entry route fits your passport and trip?

options.label: Eligible for the current 14-day visa exemption
The ROP wizard offers me an eVisa

oman_none_result.summary: GCC citizens do not need an Oman visa.
oman_none_result.note: Citizens of Bahrain, Kuwait, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates enter Oman without a visa. No form is required.

oman_exempt_result.summary: You do not need an eVisa for this 14-day exempt trip.
oman_exempt_result.note: Read every current condition, including the second-group qualification rules. The 14-day exemption cannot be extended or converted. No eVisa form is required for a qualifying trip.

oman_evisa_result.summary: Apply for the visa subtype shown by the Royal Oman Police wizard.

forms.name: Oman eVisa
forms.deadline: Apply at least 4 days before arrival; processing can vary

oman_evisa_result.note: Use the fee, stay duration and conditions shown for the exact subtype in your eligibility result.

oman_check_result.summary: Check the current exemption lists and ROP wizard.
oman_check_result.note: Start with the Foreign Ministry's current two-group exemption page. If it does not cover the trip, enter the real passport and GCC-residence status in the Royal Oman Police wizard.

qatar_eligibility.label: What does Qatar's live visa checker show for your passport and status?

options.label: Apply for Hayya Tourist Visa A1
Apply for another offered Hayya category

qatar_none_result.summary: GCC citizens do not need a Qatar visa.
qatar_none_result.note: Citizens of Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates enter without a visa. Hayya says a passport or GCC ID is enough for this status.

qatar_free_result.summary: You do not need a paid Hayya tourist visa for this free-entry route.
qatar_free_result.note: Read and meet every condition shown by the live checker for the passport. More than 102 countries are eligible for free entry, but the exact stay and document conditions vary.

qatar_a1_result.summary: Apply for the Hayya Tourist Visa A1.
qatar_a1_result.note: Qatar Tourism says the A1 route requires a hotel reservation during the application and asks for payment after approval.

qatar_hayya_result.summary: Use the Hayya category shown by the live checker.

forms.name: Hayya e-Visa
forms.fee: QAR 100 tourist visa; confirm the offered category

qatar_hayya_result.note: A2, A3 and A4 serve different residence, visa-status or companion groups. Use only the category offered for the applicant.

qatar_check_result.summary: Use the live Qatar Tourism checker before opening Hayya.
qatar_check_result.note: Enter the real passport, GCC status and current residence or qualifying-visa answers. Free-entry travellers should not be sent to a paid A1 application.

bahrain_route.label: Which Bahrain route does the official eligibility check show?

bahrain_arrival_result.summary: Follow the visa-on-arrival conditions shown for your passport.
bahrain_arrival_result.note: The on-arrival route does not require this online eVisa form. It is a separate eligibility path and is not necessarily free. Entry remains subject to the conditions and the immigration officer's decision.

bahrain_product.label: Which Visit eVisa product does the eligibility result offer?

bahrain_two_week_result.summary: Apply for the eligible two-week single-entry Visit eVisa.

forms.name: Bahrain two-week single-entry Visit eVisa
forms.deadline: Approximately 3-5 working days; exceptional cases can take longer

bahrain_two_week_result.note: The published total is BD 9 for the visa plus BD 4 for the application. Read the live product conditions before paying.

bahrain_three_month_result.summary: Apply for the eligible three-month multiple-entry Visit eVisa.

forms.name: Bahrain three-month multiple-entry Visit eVisa
forms.deadline: Approximately 3-5 working days; exceptional cases can take longer

bahrain_three_month_result.note: The published total is BD 25 for issuance plus BD 4 for the application. Read the live product conditions before paying.

bahrain_one_year_result.summary: Apply for the eligible one-year multiple-entry Visitor eVisa.

forms.name: Bahrain one-year multiple-entry Visitor eVisa
forms.deadline: Approximately 3-5 working days; exceptional cases can take longer

bahrain_one_year_result.note: Use this product only when it appears in the official eligibility result. Read the validity and period-of-stay conditions before paying.

bahrain_five_year_result.summary: Apply for the eligible five-year multiple-entry Visit eVisa.

forms.name: Bahrain five-year multiple-entry Visit eVisa
forms.deadline: Approximately 3-5 working days; exceptional cases can take longer

bahrain_five_year_result.note: The government service page publishes a narrower eligible-nationality pool for this product. Use it only when the live eligibility result offers it.

bahrain_guarantor_result.summary: A Bahrain guarantor must apply for this route.
bahrain_guarantor_result.note: NPRA lists airlines, places of stay, Bahrain travel agents, Bahrain companies and Bahrain citizens as possible guarantors. This is not the direct traveller eVisa form.

bahrain_check_result.summary: Check both official lists and run the NPRA eligibility tool.
bahrain_check_result.note: Use passport nationality, current GCC status and the real purpose. Do not start a paid online application merely because a country appears on the separate on-arrival list.

tanzania_route.label: Which Tanzania route fits the passport and purpose?

tanzania_exempt_result.summary: No Tanzania visa form is required for this visa-exempt route.
tanzania_exempt_result.note: Confirm the passport on the current Immigration Services exemption list. Do not pay for an eVisa when the exact passport and trip are exempt.

tanzania_ordinary_result.summary: Apply for the Ordinary Visa on the government portal.

forms.name: Tanzania Ordinary Visa
forms.deadline: Normal applications are processed within 10 days

tanzania_ordinary_result.note: The Ordinary Visa is the normal tourism route except for United States passport holders. It is valid for up to 90 days.

tanzania_multiple_result.summary: Use the Multiple Visa route for United States passport tourism.

forms.name: Tanzania Multiple Visa
forms.deadline: Normal applications are processed within 10 days

tanzania_multiple_result.note: The guidelines require United States passport holders to use Multiple Visa for tourism even when only one entry is planned.

tanzania_transit_result.summary: Use Transit Visa only for onward transit to another country.

forms.name: Tanzania Transit Visa
forms.deadline: Normal applications are processed within 10 days

tanzania_transit_result.note: Transit Visa is not for tourism. It permits no more than 7 days and requires destination visa and/or onward-ticket evidence.

tanzania_check_result.summary: Read the current exemption, referral and visa-type guidance before applying.
tanzania_check_result.note: The fee and processing route depend on passport and purpose. Referral cases must apply online and wait for approval.

ethiopia_route.label: Which Ethiopia tourist-entry route fits the passport and stay?

ethiopia_arrival_result.summary: Use the separate Tourist Visa on Arrival route shown for the passport.
ethiopia_arrival_result.note: Check the current official on-arrival list and its conditions. This result does not send the traveller to the paid online eVisa form.

forms.agency: Immigration and Citizenship Service of Ethiopia
forms.deadline: Normally 3 days; apply at least 3 days before intended arrival

ethiopia_30_result.note: Validity starts from the intended entry date entered in the application.

ethiopia_90_result.summary: Apply for the 90-day single-entry Tourist eVisa.

forms.name: Ethiopia 90-day Tourist eVisa
forms.agency: Immigration and Citizenship Service of Ethiopia
forms.deadline: Normally 3 days; apply at least 3 days before intended arrival

ethiopia_90_result.note: Validity starts from the intended entry date entered in the application.

ethiopia_check_result.summary: Confirm the exact entry point and passport route with Immigration and Citizenship Service.
ethiopia_check_result.note: The official pages reviewed did not publish a current eVisa port list or confirm land-border use. Do not pay on the assumption that a planned land crossing accepts the eVisa.

morocco_eligibility.label: What result does the official Accès Maroc eligibility checker show?

morocco_exempt_result.summary: No Morocco visa form is required for this visa-exempt route.
morocco_exempt_result.note: Use the live government-linked checker for the exact passport and circumstances. If it confirms visa-free entry, do not pay an eVisa intermediary.

morocco_evisa_result.summary: Apply for the Morocco eVisa only after the checker confirms eligibility.

forms.name: Morocco eVisa
forms.agency: Kingdom of Morocco Ministry of Foreign Affairs, African Cooperation and Moroccan Expatriates
forms.deadline: 72 Moroccan working hours standard / 24 express

morocco_evisa_result.note: The non-government-suffix domain is linked by the Ministry, which says Department engineers and technicians developed the platform. Verify the link from diplomatie.ma before paying.

morocco_consular_result.summary: Follow the consular visa route shown by the official checker.
morocco_consular_result.note: Do not submit and pay for an eVisa when the checker routes the passport to a consular visa.

morocco_aevm_result.summary: Follow the AEVM route shown by the official checker.
morocco_aevm_result.note: AEVM is a separate route. Use the instructions returned for the exact passport and trip instead of the eVisa form.

morocco_check_result.summary: Run the Accès Maroc eligibility check before choosing any paid route.
morocco_check_result.note: The checker asks about nationality, residence, document type, trip purpose and qualifying visas. A visa-exempt traveller needs no paid eVisa form.

jamaica_route.label: Are you arriving in Jamaica as a visitor or resident?

jamaica_c5_result.summary: Submit the free Electronic Passenger Declaration (C5) on the government portal.

forms.name: Jamaica Electronic Passenger Declaration (C5)
forms.agency: Passport, Immigration and Citizenship Agency and Jamaica Customs Agency
forms.deadline: Up to 30 days before travel

jamaica_c5_result.note: The current portal is enterjamaica.gov.jm. PICA says no third party was contracted to provide this form. C5 is separate from any passport-specific visa requirement.

jamaica_no_form_result.summary: No Jamaica arrival C5 is needed when the traveller is not entering Jamaica.
jamaica_no_form_result.note: Run the route again for an actual arrival. Transit circumstances can differ, so follow the carrier and border instructions for the itinerary.

forms.deadline: Complete electronically before arrival

bahamas_c17_result.note: The .gov.bs portal is officially authorized and identifies Exempt Technologies as the developer. Save the QR code for the designated customs lane.

bahamas_oral_result.summary: Use the oral baggage-declaration route for this visitor case.
bahamas_oral_result.note: The current government page says a visitor with only used personal belongings makes an oral baggage declaration. Do not open an unnecessary paid or digital filing service.

bahamas_pilot_result.summary: Follow the dedicated Bahamas Digital Arrival Card pilot instructions supplied for the selected flight.
bahamas_pilot_result.note: The 5 May 2026 announcement limits the pilot to select visitors on selected flights and keeps the paper process in parallel. It does not establish a universal public form.

bahamas_check_result.summary: Confirm residence status, goods and any selected-flight pilot notice before filing.
bahamas_check_result.note: Every returning resident uses C17. A visitor uses it for items beyond used personal belongings; a visitor with only used personal belongings uses the oral route under the government page.

aruba_result.summary: Every passenger completes the ED Card. Most air arrivals also pay a separate USD 20 sustainability fee in the same official flow.

forms.name: Aruba ED Card
forms.fee: USD $20 sustainability fee for most air arrivals; exemptions apply
forms.deadline: Within 7 days before travel

aruba_result.note: The ED Card also applies to sea arrivals, but the sustainability fee applies only to airport arrivals.

panama_result.summary: Use Panama Customs' free digital declaration for goods and values, then save the QR response code.

forms.name: Digital Sworn Traveler Declaration
forms.deadline: File and present within the official 72-hour window

panama_result.note: The portal supports Spanish and English. One declaration may cover a family group; the QR does not replace customs inspection.

peru_result.summary: Peru Migraciones creates the TAM Virtual automatically at immigration control. Use the free official lookup afterward.

forms.name: Virtual Andean Migration Card lookup
forms.deadline: After the movement has been recorded

peru_result.note: This is a post-control movement record, not a form to submit before travelling. Review the authorized stay shown on the downloaded TAM.

brazil_eligibility.label: Which passport will you use for Brazil?

options.label: Passport is visa-exempt under current Brazil rules

forms.name: Brazil Electronic Visitor Visa
forms.agency: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Brazil; application administered by VFS Global
forms.deadline: Apply early; processing is up to 10 business days after verified submission

brazil_evisa_result.note: The .com application host is a government-designated commercial contractor, not a government suffix. Verify it through the Ministry of Foreign Affairs page on gov.br.

brazil_exempt_result.summary: Do not buy an e-Visa when the travel passport is visa-exempt under Brazil's current official rules.
brazil_exempt_result.note: Recheck the current exemption and permitted-stay rules on gov.br before travel.

brazil_other_result.summary: The VFS e-Visa route is not a general application for every passport.
brazil_other_result.note: Check the Ministry of Foreign Affairs or a Brazilian consulate for the current rule and correct visa route for this passport.

forms.deadline: Available 72 hours before arrival

barbados_result.note: Save both emailed receipts: one for Immigration and one for Customs. Keep digital or printed copies for arrival.

Passport is not on the list
This passport already holds a valid Russian visa

russia_evisa_result.summary: File the unified e-visa from a personal account at evisa.kdmid.ru. Single entry, 120-day validity, 30-day stay, and a non-refundable fee.

forms.name: Unified e-visa application
forms.fee: Paid; amount shown at payment, not refunded
forms.agency: Consular Department, Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation
forms.deadline: Apply 4 to 86 days before the intended entry date

russia_evisa_result.note: Entry and exit must both use crossing points on the approved list, and processing takes up to 4 calendar days. Use an email other than Gmail for the account.

russia_regular_visa_result.summary: A passport outside the 64-state list has no online e-visa route. Apply for a regular visa at a Russian diplomatic mission or consular post.
russia_regular_visa_result.note: Any site offering an online Russia e-visa for a passport outside that list is not the government route.

russia_valid_visa_result.summary: No e-visa needed. The ministry says a valid Russian visa in the same passport covers the trip without the e-visa restrictions.
russia_valid_visa_result.note: A regular visa cannot be extended by obtaining an e-visa.

jordan_restricted.label: Is your passport on the Interior Ministry's restricted list (prior approval required), or is it an Arab nationality the pass is not sold to?

options.label: Queen Alia Airport (Amman) or Sheikh Hussein Bridge

jordan_pass_question.label: Will you buy the official Jordan Pass before arrival and stay at least 2 whole nights (3 days)?

options.label: No, I will pay at the border

jordan_pass_result.summary: Buy the pass on jordanpass.jo, print the PDF, and show it at the visa office: the JD 40 single-entry visa fee is waived and over 40 sites including Petra are covered.

forms.name: Jordan Pass
forms.agency: Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities of Jordan
forms.deadline: Buy before arrival; the terms deny the visa exemption to passes bought after arrival

jordan_pass_result.note: The pass is not a visa: border officers still grant it. The waiver needs a stay of at least 2 whole nights, and leaving earlier means paying at the airport.

jordan_visa_on_arrival_result.summary: Pay the single-entry tourist visa at the border. No online form is needed before travel.
jordan_visa_on_arrival_result.note: Site tickets are then paid separately at each entrance. If Petra is on the plan, compare with the JD 70 pass before deciding: the pass also carries the visa fee.

jordan_aqaba_result.summary: The pass FAQ says non-restricted nationalities arriving at Aqaba Airport do not need a visa.
jordan_aqaba_result.note: Attraction tickets are paid separately unless a pass is bought. Restricted nationalities must obtain a visa from a Jordanian embassy before travel. Confirm the current Aqaba zone rule before relying on it.

jordan_embassy_result.summary: Restricted nationalities need prior approval, so apply at a Jordanian diplomatic mission before travel.
jordan_embassy_result.note: The Interior Ministry e-service at eservices.moi.gov.jo/MOI_EVISA is an account-login workflow for applications submitted from outside the Kingdom, with a JD 2 service allowance and JD 1000 guarantee per invited person. Any site selling an instant online visa for a restricted nationality is not the government route.
